mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_PW AS memberPw, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, RANK AS rank, STATUS AS status FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, RANK, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{memberPw}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{rank}, #{status} )
